keywords: The Appellants challenged an order of the District Court of Galle refusing special leave under Section 48(4) of the Partition Act following their absence at trial. Held - such an order is not a final judgement appealable as of right under Section 754(1) of the Civil Procedure Code, but an interlocutory order appealable only with prior leave under Section 754(2). Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: Section 760A of the Civil Procedure Code
